approval.statement_ar: اعتمد وحدث هوية اف بي تي بالشعار المحسن (لاشيء آخر من معايير الهوية)
approval.scope: the logo only: all nine refinement items shown on the review canvas 'FPT Logo v2' (vector master, one slant, one cut width, concentric arcs, one baseline, matched ticks, 20% tile corner + optical placement, small-size cut, vector wordmark with white, Arabic and bilingual lockups). No other identity standard changes.

construction.unit: u = one third of the stroke
construction.P_bowl_centre: on the P stem line, halfway between the bar line (3u) and the cut line (8.5u)
construction.T_arc_radius: P outer radius + 1u, same centre as the P bowl

gradient.axis: top-left corner to bottom-right corner of the tile

small_cut.use: every rendered size at or below 32 px (favicons, smallest app icons); never above 32 px

full_bleed.use: iOS app icon (iOS applies its own mask), store listings, apple-touch-icon

round.use: social avatars (circle crop), PWA maskable icon

horizontal_en.wordmark: Fiper Pro Traders, D-DIN PRO ExtraBold, tracking -0.02 em, cap height = monogram cap height (11.5u), sitting on the monogram cap line and baseline

horizontal_ar.tile_position: right of the Arabic name (the mark itself is never mirrored)
horizontal_ar.wordmark: فايبر برو تريدرز, IBM Plex Sans Arabic Bold, cap metric 10.5u, baseline = monogram baseline

bilingual.arabic: same width as the English line; the two-line block runs from the monogram cap line to the descender tip

vertical_en.alignment: wordmark centred exactly on the tile axis

vertical_ar.alignment: wordmark centred exactly on the tile axis

lettering_sources.latin: D-DIN PRO ExtraBold 1.000 (Datto Inc., SIL Open Font License 1.1), npm @fontpkg/d-din-pro@1.0.0, file D-DIN-PRO-800-ExtraBold.otf sha256 a8c736883fd6ebd97ad51f38e993ef960cccc124214f5bcca339fc5f0a7bef28 — logo lettering source only, NOT a brand typeface
lettering_sources.arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic Bold (IBM, SIL Open Font License 1.1), npm @ibm/plex-sans-arabic@1.1.0, file fonts/complete/woff/IBMPlexSansArabic-Bold.woff sha256 27d56b76c0a84a9330ba84d05bab68dcd6d2321770b98a1a9d28652062ffde55 — already the brand Arabic face
lettering_sources.outlined: all lettering is converted to outlines in every file; no font is needed to display the logo

v1_defects_fixed.format: the five official v1 files are JPEG on white, no vector, no transparency
v1_defects_fixed.slant: edges ranged 12.0 to 13.9 deg -> all 12.5 deg
v1_defects_fixed.cuts: 29 and 38 px; P/T gap 28 -> 50 px (on the 1223 px tile) -> one width, 1u
v1_defects_fixed.arcs: f shoulder centres 11.7 px apart; T arc 63 px off the P bowl centre -> concentric
v1_defects_fixed.baseline: f stood 22 px below P and T -> one baseline
v1_defects_fixed.tile_corner: 10.6% in fpt-logo-icon-rounded.jpeg vs 20% in the other four files -> 20% everywhere
v1_defects_fixed.placement: mark shifted 0.43u (1.3% of the tile) right for optical balance
v1_defects_fixed.vertical_lockup: wordmark was 11.5 px off the tile axis -> exactly centred
v1_defects_fixed.small_sizes: mark dissolves below 32 px -> dedicated small cut
